rubriker.title: US Championship: Round 5
rubriker._rss_content: Round 5 in Saint Louis on Wednesday produced four wins in each section, as Andy Woodward beat defending champion Fabiano Caruana to join Wesley So on 3.5/5 in the open section. In the women's, Alice Lee beat Tatev Abrahamyan to reach 4.5/5, a full point ahead of three chasers, while defending champion Carissa Yip lost again.

rubriker.title: Total Chess Rating Sparking Discussion
rubriker._rss_content: Total Chess has opened a draft multi-format rating system for public feedback, combining a player's FIDE Classical, Rapid and Blitz ratings into a single Elo-compatible number. In its post on X, the company says the pilot is not meant to replace the FIDE ratings, and that the research was prepared by Dr Mehmet Mars Seven of King's College London.
